reviews.comment: Terrible professor, does not teach anything in the class. One whole group project for majority of the grade. I had to appeal final grade to the dean because he would not atleast discuss it. Do not take, I do not know how he is a professor here.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is by far the best professor I have ever had. He really cares about his students in a personal level. Teaching is his passion and you can feel it in every lecture, as he focuses on providing useful and engaging lessons and group projects. I took his MKTG448 lecture 5 years ago. And I still think about him a lot. Thanks for everything Altay! LU

I enjoyed my marketing research masters course with Dr. Dikec! He was very thorough with his syllabus and course which made it easy to be organized. He also gave us a lot of time to work on our own in our groups for our research project!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Take his class! I took him for MKTG 448 and LOVED him. He is always so kind and very clear on expectations. I was hearing from peers that their MKTG 448 was hard, but Altay made his class so enjoyable. This was my capstone and my favorite class at TAMU.
He is an awesome professor!! His class is a good amount of work but very doable. I would for sure take his class again.

Dr. Dikec is awesome! His lectures were engaging, and you could tell he really wants his students to succeed. He listened to our feedback on different assignments and even made changes to grading policies when the class suggested a more beneficial grading system. A large portion of this class is dedicated to a group project, so keep that in mind!

Professor Dikec is awesome! His class/assigned project is difficult and he expects you to put a lot of effort into the group project, so be prepared to take initiative and constantly problem solve. His project provides students with a great real-world work experience to grow a lot! I highly recommend, just be ready to work outside of class time.

Altay Dikec has been one of my favorite professors at Texas A&M. I have taken two of his classes and I have been able to learn so much. In this class, you have to purchase case studies and we had a group project, 2 exams, and a group simulation with a report. It was definitely challenging at times but he gave us all the tools to succeed. Thank you!
Awesome professor and literally so funny, like everything he said made me laugh and i loved reading his emails! Interesting information and overall awesome class. 15/10 would recommend!!

Best professor ever. He used to teach excel, but now teaches services marketing (mktg 325), marketing for health care companies (mktg 444), and marketing strategy (mktg 448). Take him for whatever classes you can! Very understanding and tries his best to really help you absorb the material he lectures on. The class simulation was difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: This professor loves what he teaches and strives to be the best version of himself every day. He really does care about this subject and his students; he wants them to learn as much as possible as well as making it enjoyable. I did learn a lot and I am so thankful I had the chance to be his student.

Altay is the best professor you will have at TAMU. He really cares about his students. It doesn't matter what class he is teaching, take it!! You will learn so much from him. He wants to help you learn and succeed in whatever you are doing.

Altay is an incredible professor! He cares so much about his students and values learning more than grades. I wish I had him for every class, he's my favorite professor I've had at A&M! His lectures are engaging and he is open to help students outside his class.

Dr. Dikec is a great professor and I definitely recommend taking him if you have the chance. 2 essay tests and one group project competition. No textbook but need to get case study materials. He is very flexible, responsive, engaging, and overall a great guy. Not a blowoff class but definitely enjoyable!

Professor Dikec is truly a one of a kind professor and human being . His classes are informative and applicable to the real world, and he offers countless opportunities for one-on-one assistance outside of class. Aside from academics, he cares and values all of his students deeply. An absolute GEM! Recommend him x 10000!!

Hands down the best professor I have ever had at Texas A&M. You have your professors that show they care about you, and then there's Professor Dikec. He goes above and beyond unlike any other professor and provides priceless real world scenarios and insight. He loves his students like his own and encourages everyone to reach out to him. 100/10!!

Altay is AMAZING! This semester was a challenge with the combo of in-person/online class, but he handled it really well. I attended class completely online, but I feel as if I really know him & he really knows me (& I learned a ton). He truly cares about his students & wants us to succeed. His class requires fair effort, but it is so worth it!!

If you are looking on here, trying to decide if Altay Dikec is a good professor, then I'm here to tell you HE IS THE BEST! I just finished taking my 4th course with him. That's how amazing he is. He not only teaches you, but invest time in you. His is exams are easy, but thats because you learn so much more than just what exams can teach you.

Dikec wants everyone to succeed and learn. He gives us plenty of time for take-home tests and makes them challenging but doable (especially if you watch the review sessions). He's super helpful outside of class if you have questions. All around great prof.

Very well organized and structured class. He is very helpful with any and all emails I sent. All of the assignments are available since day 1. Each week has different assignments due, but I messed up cause some assignments are still accepted late but some are not allowed past midnight. Overall great professor and nice class.

Altay has a kind soul. He is passionate and cares about every person that walks into the classroom. You'd be impressed to see this man memorize everyone's name before syllabus week is even over. He's very thoughtful with his lesson plans and there's a great variety (wonderful lectures, key note speakers, articles, class activities, projects, etc.)

Professor Dikec is very kind and cares about his students, but I was disappointed by this course. The material is very straight forward, but he is a very picky and in my opinion, an unfair grader. This should be an A class for me but it is not because of my exam short answers. You also can't calculate your grade or ever know where you stand. CMON!!
Prof. Altay is one of the best professors I've ever had. Just see the other comments to understand what I'm saying. Take this class if you want to learn a lot about services marketing.

I've taken 3 classes with him, and every semester I have seen him improve as a professor. He really cares about his students and is always asking for critiques so that he can improve. If anything I would like his classes to challenge me more. His classes are great if you need a breather class with minimal homework.
Online excel class- not very bad at all. Altay is super understanding if somehow your computer crashes and you can't do an assignment he will be very understanding.

Professor Dikec helps make Mays amazing. He is so empathetic with his students, is available for help always despite how busy he is, and is a really incredible person. All of this I noticed from an online course so that speaks strongly I feel to his character. Take this prof if you get the opportunity.

Professor Dikeç is the most inspirational and caring professor. He cares about his students and is always willing to help. He also makes sure to keep the class engaging and entertaining. I would 100% recommend him to anyone and everyone, if you dont take him you are missing out!
Such a nice guy. The class is easy and really helps your excel skills in everyday life.

Professor Altay is kind, very understanding, responsive, and overall just a great person. He is ready to help with whatever you need and very understanding when it comes to personal situations. All you have to do is the weekly assignments and occasional tests/projects online, very easy. I would highly recommend this class, he's a great man!

If you have ever worked in Excel this course (MKTG404) will be very easy for you! First half are basic things from Excel, the other half is more challenging but the simnet interface is really helpful. Overall, is it possible to complete this course within 1-2 months if you try hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Perfect professor, definitely recommend! Interesting lectures, updated presentations with new companies and data. Open book exams but many informations so not easy A (rather easy B)! Not difficult quizzes and overall friendly approach.

Altay is hands down the best professor at A&M. Mays is lucky to have him and I wish all professors and people in general would be more like him. He genuinely wants to hear and implement student feedback and is an incredibly fair grader. Go to him for help in class and in life. His story is incredibly inspirational and he is an amazing educator.

This guy is awesome! After my third year in Mays I finally found a profesor I can say I actually like. He has amazing lectures that are entertaing , interesting, and easy to listen. Real life applications, you can easily visualize what he's talking about with his lectures.

Most genuine and caring professor at A&M!!! Takes time to memorize all students' names. Online quiz over each chapter. Ample opportunities for extra credit. Semester long group project. Exams are open-book/open-note. Takes attendance and likes class discussion.
Super sweet and amazing life story. Open note tests! Lots of quizzes, but manageable!
Very caring, dedicated teacher. He constantly asks for and listens to student feedback to improve his teaching. He is really there as a resource for students.
This guy really cares about his students!

Dr. Dikec is by far one of the best professors I have had the privilege of having at Texas A&M. He genuinely cares about his students and is always available for help outside of class. He memorizes every student's name and is always looking for feedback to improve his course/teaching. One downside: there is a lot of reading.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Dikec was very nice and helpful for MKTG 404. It was a one hour online class for excel. He offered extra credit if you visited him in office hours the first week. The platform used for the work was very easy to use. The information was a refresher of ISYS 210, so it was easy to do if you remember that class.

Dr. Dikec is the most respectful prof I had @ Texas A&M. He will hear you out on any problems you have with the class or even personally. He will remember everyone's name, and takes time to know you. He is always avaliable outside of class if you make arrangements. His class requires you to show up and do the best you can. Don't make it hard.

Dr. Dikec is amazing and I highly recommend taking his classes. He truly cares about his students and their opinions regarding his teaching and the course. He takes the time to learn everyone's name and know each and everyone personally. He is readily available outside of class. His tests are open book but you need to know the material well.

Dr. Dikec is one of the kindest professors I have had. He is readily available for help outside of class and takes time to get to know each of his students. I am very thankful to have had the opportunity to have such an inspirational professor.

Literally the best professor I have had at Texas A&M. Not only is he a fantastic professor, but also an amazing person. He shows that he truly cares about his students feeling included and engaged. The class is not hard, you just need to do your assignments and prepare for your exams like any other class. I would absolutely recommend him!!!

Dr. Dikec is the best professor I have had at Texas A&M. He wants to hear student's concerns and teaches the material very effectively. He is welcoming and kind and works hard to help students understand and love all the material.

Dr. Dikec is a great professor, and an overall great person. He clearly demonstrates that he cares about his students and attempts to get to know everyone. I wish he taught more classes, because I would definitely take another from him! He keeps class interesting with guest speakers, jokes, videos, and questions. I highly recommend him.

Dr. Dikec is one of the most fair professors I've had at A&M. His tests are open book, still not easy but I got A's by prepping ahead of time. Throughout the semester he took our feedback into account and adapted the course based on what we told him and what he thought was appropriate to change. Already signed up for his other class next semester!
